method: Downloaded actual MP4 streams; ffprobe checked local duration; ffmpeg extracted 12 exact requested seek positions per recommended video including beginning and end; assistant visually inspected both contact sheets. Metadata language is pl; no audio listening or full transcript factual audit was performed. Frame sampling cannot establish absence of presenter at every instant.

recommended_candidates.title: Klasa 8 - Polski rząd na emigracji i układ Sikorski-Majski
recommended_candidates.verdict: Recommended for Grade 8, with teacher framing
recommended_candidates.visuals: Animated collage of maps, historical photographs, labels and comic speech bubbles; no live on-camera presenter in the 12 reviewed samples.
caveats: Comic dialogue is an authored dramatization, not a verified historical quotation.
Some labels are small; final sample uses a postwar map, so distinguish wartime exile from postwar outcomes.
recommended_candidates.classroom_question: Dlaczego rząd Sikorskiego zdecydował się na porozumienie z ZSRS w 1941 r., mimo sowieckiej agresji na Polskę w 1939 r.?

recommended_candidates.title: Film edukacyjny "Niedźwiedź  Wojtek"
recommended_candidates.verdict: Recommended as accessible Anders/deportation context; conditional on teacher accepting a younger-looking animated narrator
recommended_candidates.visuals: Animated bear narrator, maps, dates and historical photographs; no live on-camera presenter in the 12 reviewed samples.
caveats: Cartoon bear aesthetic is designed for younger children; use as historical-case evidence rather than the only Grade 8 explanation.
The wider subject is Wojtek and the Polish II Corps, not a complete account of the government in exile.
recommended_candidates.classroom_question: Jak powstanie armii Andersa zmieniło los deportowanych Polaków — żołnierzy i ludności cywilnej?

rejected_candidates.reason: On-camera seated talking-head lecturer in 8 of 12 sampled frames; rejected.

rejected_candidates.title: Pentape - Władysław Anders
rejected_candidates.reason: Two near-static portraits dominate all sampled frames; visually dull, not a useful explanatory clip.

issues: Configured web gateway unavailable; some fallback searches failed 403. Direct HTTPS and yt-dlp retrieval succeeded.
Browser tool returned no CDP endpoint.
Default yt-dlp extraction failed; lightweight uvx yt-dlp with installed node runtime and web,android clients succeeded.
Initial fps contact-sheet timestamps were approximate; accepted candidates were re-extracted using explicit seek times recorded in frame-sampling.json.
